registered_claim_authority: One self-contained GitHub Issue #240 CLAIM envelope validated against the operational immutable task publication for ordinary work or the exact lane-pinned retained publication for an active execution cohort.
execution_record_compatibility: research_execution_records/<task-id>/<execution-record-id>.json may preserve/freeze execution provenance but is not a mandatory pre-claim remote write
runtime_event_authority: GitHub Issue #240 issue comments authenticated by server comment metadata and separately authorized by research_control_event_authorization.json; the JSON event body is payload, not its own authentication or authorization envelope

server_event_envelope.normalized_github_envelope_from_external: REJECT; LIVE AUTHORITY MUST ENTER AS RAW ISSUE #240 COMMENT OBJECTS
server_event_envelope.bare_event_compatibility: Allowed only for explicit legacy replay/test primitives; not live authority for immutably registered tasks

session_liveness_routing.activity_evidence: latest independently verified conversation response or durable execution progress; CLAIM creation time alone is not session-liveness evidence

parallel_execution_dispatch.activation: ACTIVE cohort record exists for task

selection_rule: Run research_control_dispatch.py as the canonical control-plane route. It first preserves/adopts any owner scope whose valid CLAIM is independently observed stale, without creating a second CLAIM. If no stale-recoverable owner is observed, it delegates ordinary fresh task selection to tools/research_dispatch.py and active-cohort lane selection to tools/research_lane_dispatch.py. If both fresh selectors are empty but any valid owner lease has unknown conversation liveness, the result is VERIFY_SESSION_LIVENESS rather than NO_DISPATCH. For ordinary fresh tasks, historical state/priority/leverage/staleness ordering remains unchanged; AWAITING_REVIEW and COMPLETE are never selected. When an ACTIVE cohort exists, canonical task status is projected to COHORT_ACTIVE and task-global ownership is disabled. Live events must come from raw server-authenticated Issue #240 comments whose exact server actor is authorized. Compatible historical execution records may supply the same durable binding but cannot replace the live winning claim requirement.
interaction_budget: Recovery routing reuses existing owner state and ephemeral liveness evidence. It never adds a CLAIM for stale-session adoption. Authentication and actor authorization reuse the same Issue #240 comments already needed for semantic control events. Ordinary tasks add no new periodic poll; a liveness verification is required only when fresh dispatch is empty and a valid owner lease would otherwise cause a false NO_DISPATCH, or when stale adoption is being considered.
